use_case: Food reveal, booking push, weekend promo

timeline.label: Hook
timeline.visual: Sizzle sound + extreme close-up of dish being prepared
timeline.text: This is why you book the table.
timeline.audio: Sizzle + appetizing ambient. Warm bass enters.

timeline.label: Reveal
timeline.visual: Wide shot of the full dish being placed on a table

timeline.label: Atmosphere
timeline.visual: Quick cuts: candles, laughter, clinking glasses, packed room
timeline.audio: Full warm bed. Social ambience mixed in.

timeline.label: Scarcity
timeline.visual: Empty table by window. Reserved sign.

sound_direction: Warm, appetizing, social. 100 BPM. Restaurant ambient bed with subtle bass. Fade to silence at CTA.
export_notes: 1080p, 9:16, H.264. Food must be well-lit. Keep booking link clearly visible in last frame.
client_usage: Replace food visuals with your signature dishes. Replace text with your restaurant name and offer. Use your Brand Sound Pack.
